name: Cafayate
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

blurb.text: A wine area in Salta, one of Argentina's wine-producing provinces. Malbec leads plantings at 48%, followed by Torrontés Riojano (20%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (15%).
